tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: GitLab Get Projects
tools.description: List all projects. Use when the request specifically involves listing projects, rather than a related GitLab action.

active.description: Limit by projects that are not archived and not marked for deletion

id_after.description: Limit results to projects with IDs greater than the specified ID

id_before.description: Limit results to projects with IDs less than the specified ID

imported.description: Limit by imported by authenticated user

include_hidden.description: Include hidden projects. Can only be set by admins

include_pending_delete.description: Include projects in pending delete state. Can only be set by admins

last_activity_after.description: Limit results to projects with last_activity after specified time. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

last_activity_before.description: Limit results to projects with last_activity before specified time. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

marked_for_deletion_on.description: Date when the project was marked for deletion

membership.description: Limit by projects that the current user is a member of

min_access_level.description: Limit by minimum access level of authenticated user

order_by.description: Return projects ordered by field. storage_size, repository_size, wiki_size, packages_size are only available to admins. Similarity is available when searching and is limited to projects the user has access to.

owned.description: Limit by owned by authenticated user

repository_checksum_failed.description: Limit by projects where repository checksum is failed

repository_storage.description: Which storage shard the repository is on. Available only to admins

search.description: Return list of projects matching the search criteria

search_namespaces.description: Include ancestor namespaces when matching search criteria

simple.description: Return only the ID, URL, name, and path of each project

sort.description: Return projects sorted in ascending and descending order

topic.description: Comma-separated list of topics. Limit results to projects having all topics

topic_id.description: Limit results to projects with the assigned topic given by the topic ID

updated_after.description: Return projects updated after the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

updated_before.description: Return projects updated before the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

wiki_checksum_failed.description: Limit by projects where wiki checksum is failed

with_custom_attributes.description: Include custom attributes in the response

with_merge_requests_enabled.description: Limit by enabled merge requests feature

with_programming_language.description: Limit to repositories which use the given programming language

tools.name: create_project_issue
tools.title: GitLab Create Project Issue
tools.description: Create an issue. Use when the request specifically involves creating project issue, rather than a related GitLab action.

assignee_id.description: [Deprecated] The ID of a user to assign issue

assignee_ids.description: The array of user IDs to assign issue

confidential.description: Boolean parameter if the issue should be confidential

created_at.description: Date time when the issue was created. Available only for admins and project owners.

discussion_locked.description: Boolean parameter indicating if the issue's discussion is locked

discussion_to_resolve.description: The ID of a discussion to resolve, also pass `merge_request_to_resolve_discussions_of`

due_date.description: Date string in the format YEAR-MONTH-DAY

epic_id.description: The ID of an epic to associate the issue with

epic_iid.description: The IID of an epic to associate the issue with (deprecated)

iid.description: The internal ID of a project issue. Available only for admins and project owners.

issue_type.description: The type of the issue. Accepts: issue, incident, test_case, requirement, task, ticket

merge_request_to_resolve_discussions_of.description: The IID of a merge request for which to resolve discussions

milestone.description: The title of a project or ancestor-group milestone to assign the issue to. Mutually exclusive with `milestone_id`.

milestone_id.description: The ID of a milestone to assign issue

project_id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project

severity.description: The severity of the issue. Only applies to incidents. Accepts: unknown, low, medium, high, critical

start_date.description: Date string in the format YEAR-MONTH-DAY

tools.name: create_merge_request
tools.title: GitLab Create Merge Request
tools.description: Create a merge request. Use when the request specifically involves creating merge request, rather than a related GitLab action.

add_labels.description: Comma-separated label names to add to a merge request.

allow_collaboration.description: Allow commits from members who can merge to the target branch.

approvals_before_merge.description: Number of approvals required before this can be merged

assignee_ids.description: The IDs of the users to assign the merge request to, as a comma-separated list. Set to 0 or provide an empty value to unassign all assignees.

description.description: Description of the merge request. Limited to 1,048,576 characters.

labels.description: Comma-separated label names for a merge request. Set to an empty string to unassign all labels.

merge_after.description: Date after which the merge request can be merged.

milestone.description: The title of a project or ancestor-group milestone to assign the merge request to. Mutually exclusive with `milestone_id`.

milestone_id.description: The global ID of a milestone to assign the merge request to.

project_id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

remove_labels.description: Comma-separated label names to remove from a merge request.

remove_source_branch.description: Flag indicating if a merge request should remove the source branch when merging.

reviewer_ids.description: The IDs of the users to review the merge request, as a comma-separated list. Set to 0 or provide an empty value to unassign all reviewers.

squash.description: Squash commits into a single commit when merging.

target_project_id.description: The target project of the merge request defaults to the :id of the project.

title.description: The title of the merge request.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search Notion
tools.description: Search pages and databases the Notion connection can access.

page_size.description: Max results to return (Notion caps at 100).

query.description: Text to search titles for. Omit to list everything shared with the integration.

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor.
